title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-05 (PIN M17, 6-level effort menu) — OURS' 6-tier menu {ultra, max, xhigh, high, medium, low} must survive the merge (upstream's 4-item test would have caught a regression the OTHER way — 06 §2). The 6-item count itself: coordinator cross-check against the model_state crate-test result from the full gate (named in the README cell table). This is the closest the unmodified driver gets to 'open /effort post-merge'.
